lithosphere degradation, as opposed to lithosphere removal, is a more appropriate term for the Cenozoic tectonics and magmatism of the Sierra Nevada and adjacent regions of the western United States.

CML is not yet entirely removed beneath the Sierrans.
the Sierra Nevada and the Walker Lane are both regions of lithosphere removal, but that the processes of removal are not complete beneath the range front.
